ios.desc:
Dear VanMoof riders,   we have created a simple app to enable you to generate your unique digital key and keep riding even if the servers go down.


Save your bike key on your phone and keep riding*. We don’t capture any data, everything is saved securely on your phone so you can have a direct connexion to your bike if VanMoof services are down. Just generate your local key and enjoy peace of mind again.


This app is developed as an initiative from Cowboy during a one-day hackathon as we share the belief that every single bike deserves to be on the road. 


 * Only supporting S3/X3 models for now.

quotes.text: "As long as you don’t change your phone" being a requirement for continuing to use the bike I paid for is ludicrous. That said I saw this in an article just yesterday, maybe it solves the problem created by techbros wanting to build smart 'everythings': https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bikey-app/id6451117309
quotes.story_title: Electric bike, stupid love of my life
